{{Short description|Almost-contact manifold}}
In the mathematical field of [[differential geometry]], a '''Kenmotsu manifold''' is an [[almost-contact manifold]] endowed with a certain kind of [[Riemannian metric]]. They are named after the Japanese mathematician Katsuei Kenmotsu.

== Definitions ==
Let <math>(M, \varphi, \xi, \eta)</math> be an [[almost-contact manifold]]. One says that a [[Riemannian metric]] <math>g</math> on <math>M</math> is adapted to the almost-contact structure <math>(\varphi, \xi, \eta)</math> if:
<math display=block>\begin{align}
g_{ij}\xi^j&=\eta_i\\
g_{pq}\varphi_i^p\varphi_j^q&=g_{ij}-\eta_i\eta_j.
\end{align}</math>
That is to say that, relative to <math>g_p,</math> the vector <math>\xi_p</math> has length one and is orthogonal to <math>\ker \left(\eta_p\right);</math> furthermore the restriction of <math>g_p</math> to <math>\ker \left(\eta_p\right)</math> is a [[Hermitian manifold|Hermitian metric]] relative to the [[Almost complex manifold|almost-complex structure]] <math>\varphi_p\big\vert_{\ker \left(\eta_p\right)}.</math> One says that <math>(M, \varphi, \xi, \eta, g)</math> is an ''almost-contact metric manifold''.{{sfnm|1a1=Blair|1y=2010|1p=44}}

An almost-contact metric manifold <math>(M, \varphi, \xi, \eta, g)</math> is said to be a '''Kenmotsu manifold''' if{{sfnm|1a1=Blair|1y=2010|1p=98}}
<math display=block>\nabla_i\varphi_j^k=-\eta_j\varphi_i^k-g_{ip}\varphi_j^p\xi^k.</math>
